name: test-portal
description: SWAP 2K26 Mobile Test Portal — monorepo orchestration (backend + frontend)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.prebuild: npm install --prefix backend --include=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend && node scripts/build-static.mjs
